name: lean_low_incremental
extra_system: Speed rule: after a plan of at most a few lines (part type, key params, first feature), call new_part and build the params plus the base feature in your first apply_ops. Design each later feature only after the previous one is built and its report checked. Use round engineering numbers. Never derive exact coordinates of a profile in your head: write vertices as param expressions in add_polygon points and let the solver place them.
about: Low effort plus an explicit build-incrementally instruction.
